summary: My Earth Information Jukebox turns EIC imagery into immersive, multi-instrument soundscapes using spatial audio. It offers a new orchestra-inspired sonification technique to understand visual data through.
details:
It scans visual data column-by-column, translating colors, brightness, and patterns into a coordinated musical arrangement with Spatial Audio. Master volume dynamically scales to ensure balanced audio presence. Sudden micro-changes in pixel grids trigger one-off accent chords for a neat effect.

I thought deeply about making data sonically comprehensible. Current techniques have limitations or are poorly acquainted to tackle noise in data. So I hope my ideas can allow for blind or low-vision people to better grasp visual information.

Tools: Svelte, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Hardware: Macbook Air M1. Software: Zed (the coding editor), Safari, and Helium (Google Chrome alternative)
dataRefs: Hubble Snaps a Special Stellar Nursery
